question: Across four non-overlapping retained hourly cohorts, did any exact BTC, ETH, or SOL interval-composition package have all four minimum-size taker-buy trade prints within one second at a gross price sum strictly below its one-pUSD payout floor?

prior_payoff_evidence.role: exact forecast-independent interval transitivity and current-population rejection

selection.rule: Use the complete BTC ETH SOL aligned sets beginning at 08:45 09:45 10:45 and 11:45 UTC on 2026-08-26. These four non-overlapping hourly cohorts were fixed from retained market metadata before trade access.

official_source.source_contract: GET /trades accepts a comma-separated market condition-ID array, limit at most 10000, offset, takerOnly, and side.

decision.minimum_trade_size_shares: exact maximum market minimum, expected five
decision.strict_signal_gate: Every package token must have a taker BUY row at or above minimum size within one second and their price sum must be strictly below one pUSD.
decision.complete_response_gate: Response row count must be strictly below the 10000 row limit; equality is incomplete and authorizes no retry or claim.
decision.historical_role: rejection-only recurrence signal, never atomic owned execution or executable-depth proof
decision.conditional_next_step: Only a strict signal may schedule one separately frozen prospective exact CLOB capture on a distinct aligned future set.

retry_policy: This exact 48-condition trade request is one-use. Preserve any empty partial limit-hit mismatched or failed response and do not paginate narrow alias or refetch to obtain a signal.
